build_semantic_segmentor: build a SemanticSegmentor model from a detectron2 config with backbone and sem_seg_head
build_sem_seg_head: build a semantic segmentation head from config using SEM_SEG_HEADS_REGISTRY by name
create_sem_seg_fpn_head: create a SemSegFPNHead that takes FPN features and predicts per-pixel segmentation logits
run_semantic_segmentor_forward: run the SemanticSegmentor forward pass on batched inputs to get per-pixel segmentation predictions
review_sem_seg_losses: review the SemSegFPNHead losses method that computes cross-entropy loss with ignore value
